title: Storm Chasers / Raging Thunderhead
summary: Unleash the storm event and manage the lesser thunderheads' splitting adds.
overview: Unleash the storm event and manage the lesser thunderheads' splitting adds.

roles.label: Everyone
tips: Expect three adds from every lesser thunderhead and control the splitting targets deliberately.

sections.title: Encounter plan
bullets: When the three checked Storm Chaser templates are absent and the controller remains, a chaser death summons three Thunderheads and a Raging Thunderhead.
Each lesser Thunderhead splits into three Stormfronts when killed.
The split announces that the raging storm grows stronger.

notes: Approval E371. Source review only; deployment, database spell lists and live balance have not been verified.
The growth emote is verified; exact Raging Thunderhead stat scaling is not defined in these reviewed scripts.
